entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you with the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. I... I think I need to return something? I bought a jersey and it just doesn't fit right. The website was a bit confusing.
I can certainly help you look into that. To start, could you tell me a bit more about the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
I guess it's a preference? It's the wrong size. I ordered my usual size, but this one is just way too tight across the chest. I don't understand, all my other ones fit fine.
I understand. Sizing can sometimes vary between collections. Do you have your order number handy so I can pull up the details?
Um, yes, I think so. Let me see... It's VF88602. I just want to do an exchange, but I couldn't figure out how. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I'm happy to help. Let me just pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the ClubFit Jersey, delivered on December 4th. One moment while I check the return eligibility.
Okay... I hope it's not too late. I got so overwhelmed with the holidays.
No problem at all. I've just checked our policy, and you are well within the 90-day return window. We can definitely get this sorted out for you.
Oh, thank goodness! So I can send it back?

Absolutely. I can email you a prepaid return label right now. Once we receive the original jersey, we can either issue a full refund or process an exchange for the next size up. Which would you prefer?
An exchange would be perfect! I really like the jersey, it was just the wrong size that was the problem.

Excellent. I have just sent that return label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off at any post office. I've also made a note on your account to process the exchange as soon as it arrives. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you so much, Alex. You've been a great help.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day!
